title: Users & roles
description: Search accounts, assign roles, suspend accounts and revoke sessions. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
readOnly: You can view roles but not change them (requires users.manage).

status.title: Account status
status.suspendBody: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in to the app or the admin.
status.reactivateBody: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.
status.cannotSuspendSelf: You cannot suspend your own account.
status.staffNeedsManage: Staff accounts can only be suspended by holders of users.manage.
status.privilegedLocked: Owner and admin accounts can only be changed by an owner or holders of users.manage_admins.

roles.title: Roles
roles.selfWarning: You are editing your own roles. Removing admin roles may lock you out of these pages.
roles.ownerOnly: Only an owner can grant or remove the owner role.
roles.adminOnly: Only accounts allowed to manage admins (owners by default) can grant or remove the admin role.
roles.targetLocked: This account holds an owner or admin role that you are not allowed to change.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.revokeBody: The device will be signed out when its access token expires (at most a few minutes).
sessions.revokeAllBody: All sessions of this account will be revoked. Devices are signed out when their access tokens expire (at most a few minutes).
sessions.hidden: Sessions (IP addresses and devices) of owner and admin accounts are only visible to an owner or holders of users.manage_admins.

rolesTab.intro: Built-in roles and their permissions (defined by the server). Permissions are enforced by the API; hiding buttons in the admin is only cosmetic.
rolesTab.editIntro: Tick the permissions this role grants. Changes apply to every account with this role on its next request and are written to the audit log.
rolesTab.notEditable: The owner role always has every permission.
rolesTab.ownerOnlyEdit: Only owners can change role permissions.

roleDescriptions.owner: Full access, including managing owners and admins.
roleDescriptions.admin: Full access except managing owners and admins.
roleDescriptions.editor: Writes news, reviews, guides and encyclopedia drafts.
roleDescriptions.content_reviewer: Reviews, publishes and archives content; approves reference tours.
roleDescriptions.vehicle_data_manager: Maintains the car catalog, specs, sources, prices, media and tours.
roleDescriptions.station_manager: Maintains charging stations, tariffs, imports and station reports.
roleDescriptions.community_moderator: Moderates reviews, comments, Q&A and user reports.
